title: House of the Ebb
shortDescription: An empty berth. A brother who should not be here.
description: You and your brother Kit return to a shuttered tide-house where the ferry keeper once kept the names of the missing. A familiar keepsake, an altered record and a lantern with one impossible setting lead you to a vigil. Decide whether the shore should hear it. An original, short supernatural adventure with two endings and no timer.
author: Studio Null
